lines.translation: Siree Raag, First Mehl, Third House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਮਲੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਬੀਜੁ ਸਬਦੋ ਕਰਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਆਬ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਹਿ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: amal kar dharatee beej sabado kar sach kee aab nit dehi paanee ||
lines.translation: Make good deeds the soil, and let the Word of the Shabad be the seed; irrigate it continually with the water of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਈਮਾਨੁ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਲੈ ਭਿਸਤੁ ਦੋਜਕੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਏਵ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hoi kirasaan eemaan ja(n)maai lai bhisat dojak mooRe ev jaanee ||1||
lines.translation: Become such a farmer, and faith will sprout. This brings knowledge of heaven and hell, you fool! ||1||
Do not think that your Husband Lord can be obtained by mere words.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲ ਕੈ ਮਾਣੈ ਰੂਪ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਇਤੁ ਬਿਧੀ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maal kai maanai roop kee sobhaa it bidhee janam gavaaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You are wasting this life in the pride of wealth and the splendor of beauty. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਬ ਤਨਿ ਚਿਕੜੋ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮੀਡਕੋ ਕਮਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਲਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aib tan chikaRo ihu man meedako kamal kee saar nahee mool paaee ||
lines.translation: The defect of the body which leads to sin is the mud puddle, and this mind is the frog, which does not appreciate the lotus flower at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਉਰੁ ਉਸਤਾਦੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਉ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾ ਨਹ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhaur usataad nit bhaakhiaa bole kiu boojhai jaa nah bujhaaee ||2||
lines.translation: The bumble bee is the teacher who continually teaches the lesson. But how can one understand, unless one is made to understand? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣੁ ਸੁਨਣਾ ਪਉਣ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aakhan sunanaa paun kee baanee ihu man rataa maaiaa ||
lines.translation: This speaking and listening is like the song of the wind, for those whose minds are colored by the love of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮ ਕੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਦਿਲਹਿ ਪਸਿੰਦੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: khasam kee nadar dilahi pasi(n)de jinee kar ek dhiaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: The Grace of the Master is bestowed upon those who meditate on Him alone. They are pleasing to His Heart. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੀਹ ਕਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਪੰਜ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਥੀ ਨਾਉ ਸੈਤਾਨੁ ਮਤੁ ਕਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teeh kar rakhe pa(n)j kar saathee naau saitaan mat kat jaaee ||
lines.translation: You may observe the thirty fasts, and say the five prayers each day, but 'Satan' can undo them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਪੈ ਚਲਣਾ ਮਾਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਿਤ ਕੂ ਸੰਜਿਆਹੀ ॥੪॥੨੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhai raahi pai chalanaa maal dhan kit koo sa(n)jiaahee ||4||27||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, you will have to walk on the Path of Death, so why do you bother to collect wealth and property? ||4||27||
Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਮਉਲਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee maulaa jin jag mauliaa hariaa keeaa sa(n)saaro ||
lines.translation: He is the Master who has made the world bloom; He makes the Universe blossom forth, fresh and green.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਬ ਖਾਕੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਬੰਧਿ ਰਹਾਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aab khaak jin ba(n)dh rahaaee dha(n)n sirajanahaaro ||1||
lines.translation: He holds the water and the land in bondage. Hail to the Creator Lord! ||1||
Death, O Mullah-death will come,
so live in the Fear of God the Creator. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਤੂ ਮੁਲਾ ਤਾ ਤੂ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਖੁਦਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa too mulaa taa too kaajee jaanahi naam khudaaee ||
lines.translation: You are a Mullah, and you are a Qazi, only when you know the Naam, the Name of God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਪੜਿਆ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕੋ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਭਰੀਐ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: je bahuteraa paRiaa hovahi ko rahai na bhareeai paaee ||2||
lines.translation: You may be very educated, but no one can remain when the measure of life is full. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਕਾਜੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੁ ਤਜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੀਆ ਆਧਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee kaajee jin aap tajiaa ik naam keeaa aadhaaro ||
lines.translation: He alone is a Qazi, who renounces selfishness and conceit, and makes the One Name his Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਭੀ ਹੋਸੀ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੋ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: hai bhee hosee jaai na jaasee sachaa sirajanahaaro ||3||
lines.translation: The True Creator Lord is, and shall always be. He was not born; He shall not die. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਜ ਵਖਤ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰਹਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬ ਕੁਰਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)j vakhat nivaaj gujaarahi paRahi kateb kuraanaa ||
lines.translation: You may chant your prayers five times each day; you may read the Bible and the Koran.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖੈ ਗੋਰ ਸਦੇਈ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੀਣਾ ਖਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aakhai gor sadeee rahio peenaa khaanaa ||4||28||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, the grave is calling you, and now your food and drink are finished. ||4||28||
Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
The dogs of greed are with me.
In the early morning, they continually bark at the wind.
Falsehood is my dagger; through deception, I eat the carcasses of the dead.
I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਪਤਿ ਕੀ ਪੰਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਣੀ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai pat kee pa(n)d na karanee kee kaar ||
lines.translation: I have not followed good advice, nor have I done good deeds.
I am deformed and horribly disfigured.
Your Name alone, Lord, saves the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਏਹਾ ਆਸ ਏਹੋ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai ehaa aas eho aadhaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: This is my hope; this is my support. ||1||Pause||
With my mouth I speak slander, day and night.
I spy on the houses of others-I am such a wretched low-life!
Unfulfilled sexual desire and unresolved anger dwell in my body, like the outcasts who cremate the dead.
I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||2||
I make plans to trap others, although I appear gentle.
I am a robber-I rob the world.
I am very clever-I carry loads of sin.
I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||3||
I have not appreciated what You have done for me, Lord; I take from others and exploit them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ ਦੁਸਟੁ ਚੋਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau kiaa muhu desaa dusat chor ||
lines.translation: What face shall I show You, Lord? I am a sneak and a thief.
Nanak describes the state of the lowly.
I live as a wild hunter, O Creator! ||4||29||
Siree Raag, First Mehl, Fourth House:
There is one awareness among all created beings.
None have been created without this awareness.
